126 AM EST Mon Nov 23 2026

Patchy fog. Vsby 1 to 3 NM. 
.MON...W winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft. Patchy fog. Vsby 1 to 3 NM. 
.MON NIGHT...NW winds 15 to 20 kt. Gusts up to 25 kt...increasing to
30 kt late. Waves 2 ft. A chance of rain. 
.TUE...N winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts to 25 kt. Waves 2 to 3 ft. 
.TUE NIGHT...NE winds 10 to 15 kt with gusts to 20 kt. Waves 2 ft. 
.WED...NE winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts to 25 kt. Waves 2 ft. 
.WED NIGHT...NE winds 25 to 30 kt. Waves 3 ft. Rain likely. 
.THU...NE winds 30 kt...becoming SE in the evening, then becoming SW
25 to 30 kt after midnight. Waves 4 ft. Rain. A chance of rain after
midnight. 
.FRI...W winds 25 to 30 kt...diminishing to 15 to 20 kt after
midnight. Waves 3 ft...subsiding to 2 ft after midnight.
